name: Dorn
notes: The first three summoned cover the mine, the farm and the wood (D-624, carrying D-607's rule into content): a cast of three is the floor (D-522), and if one of D-529's arms goes unworked, hunger looks broken when it is merely unattended. ⚠ Draw order is the `order` field, not the file listing — definitions are read alphabetically, which would put a woodsman, a delver and a gatherer first and nobody on the farm.
